2117283089055445371.en_summary: Ukraine's inflation came in at 10.0%/yr. That's ABOVE its target of 5.0%/yr. 2117281863580721343.en_summary: The US could hit its $41.1T debt ceiling sooner than expected. Mario Innecco warns a Democratic House win in the midterms could trigger a 2011-style debt ceiling crisis, when gold surged from $1,400 to $1,900. National debt is just over $40.5 trillion. It could come sooner than March, even by end of the year or mid January.
2117281863580721343.zh_summary: 美國可能比預期更早觸及 41.1 兆美元債務上限。Mario Innecco 警告中期選舉民主黨贏得眾議院可能引發 2011 年式債務上限危機，當時黃金從 1400 美元飆至 1900 美元。國債剛超 40.5 兆美元。可能比三月更早到來，甚至年底或一月中。
